claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: BIBX-1382 is a weak, reversible EGFR/ERBB2 tyrosine kinase inhibitor that at 2.5 uM for 5 days is expected to produce little or no selective killing, with any antiproliferative effect likely reflecting weak EGFR-family inhibition in EGFR/ERBB2-addicted lines rather than a potent cytotoxic mechanism.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: BIBX-1382 is a weak, reversible EGFR/ERBB2 tyrosine kinase inhibitor that at 2.5 uM for 5 days is expected to produce little or no selective killing, with any antiproliferative effect likely reflecting weak EGFR-family inhibition in EGFR/ERBB2-addicted lines rather than a potent cytotoxic mechanism.
